## Description (from file header)

SurfaceIntegrityGateHook — LATHE-PRO-MS5 Forge-Triple hook.Safety gate on hard-turning programs. Blocks outputs that violate:  1. White-layer risk — `high` or `critical` with coolant ≠ flood/cryo  2. Tool wear (VB) above surface-integrity ceiling (default 0.20 mm for CBN)  3. Residual-stress requirement not met (e.g., tensile required but     process produces compressive)  4. Composite safety gate — HardTurningCapstoneEngine flagged unsafeDelegates physics to HardTurningCapstoneEngine so
